detail.longDescription: https://github.com/liyu1981/my-printables Self-hosted, Printables-inspired 3D model library. One Go binary embeds the API, React SPA, migrations, and the administrative CLI. Finally I built this printables clone for my nas to manage my 3d print models better. With Pi-in-go agent + deepseek v4.1's help. It is pretty small, even with docker image is <30MB. If you are finding another small fast management app like me, may be worth a try.
